document_title: Process Characterization Plan — Low-pH Viral Inactivation (Step 6)
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: The XMuLV criterion for this step is a back-calculated step contribution (cumulative requirement minus the clearance credited to AEX and virus filtration) under the modular ICH Q5A(R2) approach; the region is to be reported both on the mean prediction and with a prediction interval applied, and the interval-based region is the one that supports the control strategy.
The step makes no clearance claim for MVM or any other non-enveloped model virus; the claim covers the enveloped model virus (XMuLV) only.
The Plan states classification is an OUTPUT; parameter_type left 'unclassified' here.

process_steps.description: Dedicated viral-clearance step: the Protein A eluate is held at low pH to inactivate enveloped viruses (XMuLV), then neutralized. Sets the cumulative XMuLV clearance and can increase aggregate during the hold; ineffective against the non-enveloped parvovirus model MVM.

source_references.quote: The Protein A eluate is already acidic, so the pool is titrated to the inactivation pH, held for a defined time under temperature control, and then titrated to the load condition of the cation exchange step
scale-dependent variables are set so that the small-scale hold reproduces the performance of the full-scale hold
the clearance study will be executed on a scaled-down model of the hold with spiked virus
Cambridge, MA (Development)
Grafton, WI (Commercial DS)

statements.statement_text: PCP-006 defines the process characterization study for the A-Mab low-pH viral inactivation step (Step 6), written before any characterization data exist.

source_references.quote: This plan defines the process characterization study for the low-pH viral inactivation step of the A-Mab drug-substance process.

statements.statement_text: The step has 4 process parameters in scope; inactivation pH, hold time and temperature are the multivariate factors and A-Mab concentration is univariate.

source_references.quote: The step has 4 parameters in scope, of which 3 will be studied in a multivariate design and 1 in a univariate assessment

statements.statement_text: The study uses a full-factorial screen followed by a face-centred central-composite design on a qualified scale-down hold model.

source_references.quote: The response-surface study is a face-centred central composite design in the same

statements.statement_text: Low-pH inactivation is enveloped-virus specific: the step makes no clearance claim for minute virus of mice or for any other non-enveloped model virus.

source_references.quote: Non-enveloped viruses have no envelope to disrupt, and this step makes no clearance claim for minute virus of mice or for any other non-enveloped model virus.

statements.statement_text: The enveloped-virus acceptance criterion for this step is a back-calculated step contribution, not the cumulative drug-substance requirement.

source_references.quote: subtracting those contributions from the cumulative requirement leaves what this step must deliver on its own

statements.statement_text: The operating region will be reported twice, on the mean prediction and with a prediction interval applied, and the interval-based region is the one that supports the control strategy.

source_references.quote: The region will therefore be reported twice, once on the mean prediction and once with a prediction interval applied, and the second of these is the region that supports the control strategy

statements.statement_text: The criteria are applied as a set: the study passes only where every one of them holds at the same condition, over a contiguous region.

source_references.quote: Meeting them individually at different conditions is not a pass, because the process must satisfy all of them at whatever condition it is run.

statements.statement_text: The pH range is justified edge by edge, because its two failure modes are different: incomplete inactivation above and acid-induced aggregation below.

source_references.quote: The upper edge is set where incomplete inactivation becomes the limiting concern, since the reduction achieved falls as pH rises. The lower edge is set above the pH at which acid-induced aggregation of the platform antibodies has been observed

statements.statement_text: Proven acceptable ranges will be reported in two forms, and the analysis that propagates the other parameters across their normal operating ranges is the reported default.

source_references.quote: The second analysis is the reproducible default for the control strategy.

statements.statement_text: The plan states criteria only: no operating region, proven acceptable range or parameter classification is asserted in it, and every outcome is reported in PCR-006.

source_references.quote: No operating region, no proven acceptable range and no parameter classification is asserted here, and every outcome is reported in PCR-006.

statements.statement_text: Meeting the step criterion does not establish the viral safety of the drug substance; the cumulative claim is assembled in PCMR-001 from this step, PCR-008 and PCR-009.

source_references.quote: Meeting the step criterion does not establish the viral safety of the drug substance.

source_references.quote: Enveloped-virus clearance is of very high criticality, and its acceptance criterion is cumulative over the purification train instead of specific to any one step

assertions.assertion_text: Inactivation pH was ranked for multivariate study on its credible impact on the enveloped-virus inactivation and its potential to interact.

source_references.quote: Inactivation pH carries the highest rank at this step. Its consequence is two-sided. Above the top of the studied range the antibody is stable but inactivation is incomplete

assertions.assertion_text: Hold time was ranked for multivariate study on its credible impact on the enveloped-virus inactivation and its potential to interact.

source_references.quote: Hold time and temperature act on the same inactivation kinetics as pH, so their effects cannot be resolved one parameter at a time, and both are carried into the multivariate design with pH

assertions.assertion_text: Temperature was ranked for multivariate study on its credible impact on the enveloped-virus inactivation and its potential to interact.

source_references.quote: Hold time and temperature act on the same inactivation kinetics as pH, so their effects cannot be resolved one parameter at a time, and both are carried into the multivariate design with pH

assertions.assertion_text: A-Mab concentration is expected to affect neither response over a wide range.

source_references.quote: Prior knowledge indicates that protein concentration has little or no effect on inactivation kinetics or on aggregation over the range the capture step delivers

source_reference.quote: The inactivation kinetics established on the prior products transfer directly to A-Mab, and the low-pH hold is treated here as a settled platform operation.

weak_claims.rationale: A transferability claim of this weight requires a reference. The document cites @amab2009 elsewhere for exactly this basis, so the omission is not a stylistic choice; the claim stands on nothing a reader can check.
weak_claims.correct_version: Cite the A-Mab case study for the platform inactivation data, and state which prior products the kinetics were established on.
